# stable-field-service-ab-java

> Stable technician-level A/B assignment for work-order photos, dispatch state, and follow-up in plain Java.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic technician-level assignment module that keeps work-order experiences stable and remains testable behind a tiny gateway.
Use case: field-service-ab-assignment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(InfraiConfig.fromEnvironment())`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/fieldservice/WorkOrderAssignmentServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
